1.consolidated_definition: "Desnucarse": (verb) Perder su forma y consistencia original al deshacerse o disolverse en un líquido, especialmente agua.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To disintegrate: (verb) To lose its original shape and consistency by dissolving or dispersing in a liquid, especially water.
